title: Two Hands Corporation Begins External Beta Testing for EntangleX Quantum Simulator - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Micro-cap holding firm Two Hands Corporation (OTC: TWOH), which is renaming itself Quantum X Inc., has opened external beta testing of EntangleX, a browser-based GPU-accelerated quantum circuit simulator. The company stresses EntangleX is classical simulation software, not quantum hardware, and no commercial release dates, pricing or customer contracts have been finalized.

insights.claim: Two Hands Corporation (OTC: TWOH), a micro-cap technology holding firm in the process of changing its corporate identity to Quantum X Inc., has opened the base user interface of its EntangleX quantum circuit simulation software to selected external partners for third-party beta testing.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A micro-cap renaming itself around quantum while its product is still in beta is a narrative-first setup investors should discount accordingly.
insights.locator: Opening paragraph — 'Micro-cap technology holding firm Two Hands Corporation...'

insights.claim: The beta milestone follows a phase of internal development led by project lead Ujjwal Roy and CEO Emil Assentato.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Names the two people carrying the program — a thin bench relative to funded simulator competitors.
insights.locator: 'The milestone follows a phase of internal development'

insights.claim: EntangleX is a browser-based, GPU-accelerated simulation environment letting technical teams, researchers and educators model, execute and analyze quantum circuits on classical infrastructure without access to physical quantum processors.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The addressable buyer is education and early R&D, not production quantum workloads — a small and crowded market.
insights.locator: 'Designed as a browser-based, GPU-accelerated simulation environment'

insights.claim: The platform includes a visual circuit builder, a library of standard quantum algorithm templates, programmatic submission APIs, usage tracking and multi-user collaborative team workspaces, and is being engineered to support both hosted cloud access and private, customer-controlled on-premises deployments.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Usage tracking plus on-prem support signals an intended per-seat or per-site licence model once commercialization begins.
insights.locator: 'The platform includes a visual circuit builder'

themes.theme: Explicit Limits and Absent Commercial Terms

insights.claim: Two Hands Corporation emphasized that EntangleX is a classical simulation tool rather than physical quantum hardware, with simulation scale and circuit depth bounded by available GPU memory and classical processing capacity.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The company itself rules out any quantum-hardware valuation premium — the exponential state-space limit caps how far the product can scale.
insights.quote: Two Hands Corporation emphasized that EntangleX is a classical simulation tool rather than physical quantum hardware, with simulation scale and circuit depth bounded by available GPU memory and classical processing capacity.
insights.locator: 'The external beta phase will evaluate platform usability'

insights.claim: No commercial release dates, pricing or customer contracts have been finalized, with further software enhancements expected later in 2026 based on beta feedback.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: There is no revenue visibility attached to this milestone — treat it as a development update, not a monetization event.
insights.locator: 'The company expects to introduce further software enhancements later in 2026'

insights.claim: The external beta phase will evaluate platform usability, circuit-building workflow clarity, results presentation and simulation stability across independent environments.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The stated beta objectives are usability-level, implying the product is early rather than near release.
insights.locator: 'The external beta phase will evaluate platform usability'
